UPDATE campus_ingest_record SET title = CASE WHEN #{incoming.title} IS NOT NULL AND #{incoming.title} != '' AND (title IS NULL OR title = '' OR CHAR_LENGTH(title) < CHAR_LENGTH(#{incoming.title})) THEN #{incoming.title} ELSE title END, content = CASE WHEN #{incoming.content} IS NOT NULL AND #{incoming.content} != '' AND (content IS NULL OR content = '' OR CHAR_LENGTH(content) < CHAR_LENGTH(#{incoming.content})) THEN #{incoming.content} ELSE content END, original_url = CASE WHEN #{incoming.originalUrl} IS NOT NULL AND #{incoming.originalUrl} != '' AND (original_url IS NULL OR original_url = '') THEN #{incoming.originalUrl} ELSE original_url END, publish_time = CASE WHEN #{incoming.publishTime} IS NOT NULL AND publish_time IS NULL THEN #{incoming.publishTime} ELSE publish_time END, author_name = CASE WHEN #{incoming.authorName} IS NOT NULL AND #{incoming.authorName} != '' AND (author_name IS NULL OR author_name = '') THEN #{incoming.authorName} ELSE author_name END, like_count = CASE WHEN #{incoming.likeCount} IS NOT NULL THEN #{incoming.likeCount} ELSE like_count END, comment_count = CASE WHEN #{incoming.commentCount} IS NOT NULL THEN #{incoming.commentCount} ELSE comment_count END, share_count = CASE WHEN #{incoming.shareCount} IS NOT NULL THEN #{incoming.shareCount} ELSE share_count END, collect_count = CASE WHEN #{incoming.collectCount} IS NOT NULL THEN #{incoming.collectCount} ELSE collect_count END, view_count = CASE WHEN #{incoming.viewCount} IS NOT NULL THEN #{incoming.viewCount} ELSE view_count END, raw_data = CASE WHEN #{incoming.rawData} IS NOT NULL AND #{incoming.rawData} != '' AND (raw_data IS NULL OR raw_data = '' OR CHAR_LENGTH(raw_data) < CHAR_LENGTH(#{incoming.rawData})) THEN #{incoming.rawData} ELSE raw_data END, update_user_id = #{updateUserId} WHERE record_id = #{recordId} AND deleted = 0

SELECT FROM campus_ingest_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY create_time ASC, id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE campus_ingest_record SET deleted = 1, update_user_id = #{updateUserId} WHERE id IN ( SELECT id FROM ( SELECT r.id FROM campus_ingest_record r JOIN campus_ingest_task t ON t.task_id = r.task_id WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND t.deleted = 0 AND t.retention_days IS NOT NULL AND t.retention_days > 0 AND r.create_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL LEAST(t.retention_days, 3650) DAY) ORDER BY r.id ASC LIMIT #{limit} ) expired )

UPDATE campus_ingest_record SET deleted = 1, update_user_id = #{updateUserId} WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time < #{expireBefore} AND ( task_id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM campus_ingest_task t WHERE t.task_id = campus_ingest_record.task_id AND t.deleted = 0 AND t.retention_days IS NOT NULL AND t.retention_days > 0 ) ) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
